我的朋友汤姆(My Friend Tom): 围绕节日文化的A1短文:介绍本的日常、喜好与月光小院。
Ben and Tom are in the same class. After school, we play together. The moon-lit yard is not far from my home. Best of all, bowls of hot noodles are perfect in winter.
Ben likes chess very much. My friend Tom is very kind. I like my life very much. What's more, the sky turned grey before the storm.
Tom likes chicken too. Ben drinks milk every morning. We often go to the cinema together.
